description: Get events for a sport with filtering by league, participant, status, date range, bookmaker availability, and pagination support.

bookmaker.description: Only return events with odds from this bookmaker (e.g., 'Bet365')

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

participantId.description: Filter by participant/team ID (matches home or away)

skip.description: Number of events to skip for pagination

status.description: Comma-separated event statuses: pending, live, settled

name: get_events
